blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — A regional leaders’ meeting that wrapped up Thursday in the Chinese city of Shenzhen will be remembered for an unprecedented summit between China, Russia and the United States, but other moments also grabbed attention: Economy class While many of the 21 heads of state attending this week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum arrived on private planes to great fanfare — with some even met by crowds of pom-pom waving performers — Mexico’s president did things differently. Claudia Sheinbaum won praise and went viral on Chinese social media on Wednesday for taking a commercial flight in economy class from […]...
